verdicts.decision_note: The client requests revision to the uniquely identified ensuite arrangement, establishing its enclosure, shower, bathroom door, and bedroom-door layout.
The client adds concrete toilet and washing-machine positions to the bathroom layout, and the immediately following exchange confirms the requested arrangement.
First concrete dimensional-fit failure: the requested unit 1 ensuite arrangement cannot accommodate both the sink and washing machine.
The freelancer reports replacing the client-requested ensuite arrangement with an alternative layout that the client has not yet approved, creating a material value conflict.
